section_summary.extract_value: This section defines trait gratitude as a general tendency to recognize benefits and experience abundance, fostering personal and social well-being. It discusses the potential of trait gratitude to prevent or mitigate loneliness in middle-aged or older adults, citing previous research that demonstrates a negative association between gratitude and loneliness. The section also explains how theories like the broaden-and-build theory and the find-remind-and-bind theory support the idea that gratitude can lead to broadened perspectives, increased engagement, stronger social relationships, and ultimately alleviate feelings of loneliness.
